title: Instant Pricing Volume of a Northloop Payments Account
content:
**Definition.** The instant pricing volume is taken from the sale credits booked on the Northloop Payments account: when the payments account was opened fewer than 365 calendar days before the fee date, it is four times the sale credits of the last three months, the only annual measure such a young account has; when it was opened at least 365 but fewer than 1095 (1,095) calendar days before, two candidate measures are compared — the sale credits of the last twelve months and two times the sale credits of the last six months — and the larger of the two is the instant pricing volume; otherwise it is the sale credits of the last twelve months.

A window of the last three, six or twelve months takes in the ledger entries dated after the same calendar day three, six or twelve months before the fee date, up to and including the fee date. Four times the three-month sale credits, and two times the six-month sale credits, are each rounded to the cent.

## Measure by account age

| Calendar days from the opening of the payments account to the fee date | Instant pricing volume |
|---|---|
| fewer than 365 | four times the sale credits of the last three months |
| at least 365 and fewer than 1095 | the larger of the sale credits of the last twelve months and two times the sale credits of the last six months |
| 1095 or more | the sale credits of the last twelve months |

## Hypothetical worked examples

- *Account opened 200 days before the fee date; sale credits of the last three months 70000.00 USD.* The volume is four times 70000.00, that is 280000.00 USD.
- *Account opened 500 days before; twelve-month sale credits 180000.00 USD, six-month sale credits 120000.00 USD.* Two times 120000.00 is 240000.00, larger than 180000.00, so the volume is 240000.00 USD.
- *Account opened 1095 days before; twelve-month sale credits 180000.00 USD.* The volume is 180000.00 USD.
- *Boundaries.* 364 days falls in the first row, 365 in the second, 1094 in the second and 1095 in the third.
